models.name: V-JEPA 2.1
models.capabilities: Successor family learning dense, temporally consistent video features; checkpoints from 80M to 2B parameters.

models.name: π*0.6
models.capabilities: π0.6-based VLA improved with Recap, an RL-from-experience method using demonstrations, corrections and autonomous rollouts.

models.name: Marble
models.capabilities: Multimodal world model product generating persistent, editable 3D worlds from text, images or video.

models.name: Gemini Robotics 1.5
models.capabilities: VLA that 'thinks before acting' and transfers motions across embodiments; paired with Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5 for agentic multi-step tasks.

models.name: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5
models.capabilities: Embodied-reasoning model for spatial understanding, planning and tool calling; first Gemini Robotics model generally available to developers via the Gemini API (preview).

models.name: Genie 3
models.capabilities: General-purpose interactive world model generating navigable environments in real time from text prompts; positioned for training embodied agents.

models.name: MolmoAct
models.capabilities: Open action reasoning model that plans in 3D (depth-aware tokens, visual trajectory) before producing actions.

models.name: Skild Brain
models.capabilities: Embodiment-agnostic robot foundation model for locomotion and manipulation across robot types.

models.name: DeepFleet
models.capabilities: Foundation model coordinating movement of Amazon's warehouse robot fleet; Amazon reports ~10% improvement in fleet travel efficiency.

models.name: Gemini Robotics On-Device
models.capabilities: Local, low-latency version of Gemini Robotics VLA that runs on the robot and can be fine-tuned with 50–100 demonstrations.

models.name: SmolVLA
models.capabilities: Compact (~450M-parameter) open VLA trained on community LeRobot datasets, designed to run on consumer hardware.

models.name: Redwood AI
models.capabilities: 1X's onboard AI model for the NEO humanoid enabling mobile manipulation and household tasks.

models.name: V-JEPA 2 / V-JEPA 2-AC
models.capabilities: Self-supervised video world model; action-conditioned V-JEPA 2-AC enables zero-shot reach/grasp/pick-and-place planning from image goals on a Franka arm.

models.name: Isaac GR00T N1.5
models.capabilities: Updated GR00T model with improved language following and data efficiency, trained partly on synthetic GR00T-Dreams data.

models.name: π0.5
models.capabilities: VLA with improved open-world generalization (e.g. cleaning unseen homes) via co-training on heterogeneous data; weights added to openpi Sep 2025.

models.name: DYNA-1
models.capabilities: Commercial robot foundation model for high-throughput, long-duration tasks such as napkin folding.

models.name: Gemini Robotics
models.capabilities: Gemini 2.0-based VLA for general, interactive and dexterous manipulation; adapted to bi-arm and humanoid embodiments.

models.name: Gemini Robotics-ER
models.capabilities: Embodied-reasoning VLM with enhanced spatial understanding (pointing, 3D detection, grasp/trajectory prediction) for robot controllers.

models.name: Isaac GR00T N1
models.capabilities: Open foundation model for generalist humanoid robots with a dual-system (VLM + diffusion transformer action) architecture.

models.name: Newton physics engine
models.capabilities: GPU-accelerated physics engine built on NVIDIA Warp with MuJoCo Warp as primary backend; initiated by Disney Research, Google DeepMind and NVIDIA; Linux Foundation project.

models.name: MuJoCo Playground
models.capabilities: GPU-accelerated library of environments (locomotion, manipulation, classic control) for RL and sim-to-real transfer, e.g. Unitree G1, Franka Panda.

models.name: Helix
models.capabilities: Generalist VLA with a fast visuomotor 'System 1' and VLM 'System 2' providing full upper-body humanoid control, running on onboard GPUs.

models.name: Magma
models.capabilities: 8B multimodal agentic foundation model for UI navigation and robot manipulation planning (research use).

models.name: π0-FAST
models.capabilities: Autoregressive variant of π0 using the FAST frequency-space action tokenizer for faster training.

models.name: NVIDIA Cosmos (world foundation models)
models.capabilities: Family of open world foundation models — Predict (future video), Transfer (sim-to-real style transfer), Reason (physical reasoning VLM) — for synthetic data and physical AI.

models.name: Genesis / Genesis World
models.capabilities: Multi-physics simulation platform (rigid, FEM, MPM, SPH, IPC) with Python API; started as academic project Dec 2024, Genesis World 1.0 in May 2026.

models.name: π0
models.capabilities: Flow-matching VLA built on a PaliGemma VLM, pretrained on cross-embodiment data; weights released via openpi (Feb 2025).

models.name: Octo
models.capabilities: Open-source transformer diffusion policy pretrained on 800k Open X-Embodiment trajectories, fine-tunable to new robots.

models.name: LeRobot
models.capabilities: Open-source PyTorch library for end-to-end robot learning: datasets format, imitation/RL policies (ACT, Diffusion, VLAs) and low-cost hardware support.

models.name: NVIDIA Isaac Lab
models.capabilities: GPU-accelerated framework (successor to Orbit) for robot RL, imitation learning and motion planning; v3.0 supports kit-less Newton workflows.

models.name: DROID dataset
models.capabilities: Large in-the-wild manipulation dataset (~76k trajectories, 350 hours, 564 scenes) collected on a shared Franka Panda platform by 13 institutions.

models.name: RFM-1
models.capabilities: 8B-parameter multimodal robotics foundation model trained on warehouse pick data, text, images and video.

models.name: UMI (Universal Manipulation Interface)
models.capabilities: Handheld gripper data-collection system enabling in-the-wild demonstrations transferable to robot policies (Stanford, Columbia, TRI).

models.name: AutoRT
models.capabilities: System using LLM/VLM orchestration to direct fleets of robots for large-scale in-the-wild data collection with a robot constitution for safety.

models.name: Mobile ALOHA
models.capabilities: Low-cost whole-body teleoperation system and co-training recipe for bimanual mobile manipulation.

models.name: Open X-Embodiment (RT-X)
models.capabilities: Pooled dataset of 1M+ trajectories from 22 robot embodiments contributed by 21 institutions, with RT-1-X/RT-2-X models.

models.name: TRI Large Behavior Models

models.name: RT-2

models.name: Intrinsic Flowstate
models.capabilities: Web-based development environment for building, simulating and deploying industrial robot applications.

models.name: ALOHA
models.capabilities: Low-cost open-source bimanual teleoperation hardware with the ACT (Action Chunking with Transformers) imitation learning policy.

models.name: Diffusion Policy
models.capabilities: Visuomotor policy learning method representing actions as a conditional denoising diffusion process (Columbia, TRI, MIT).

models.name: RT-1 (Robotics Transformer 1)

models.name: MuJoCo

models.name: NVIDIA Omniverse

models.name: ROS 2
